title: TDB eager creator and canonical stream registration
question: Is the registered C++ creator invoked synchronously during TDB registration, with canonical/separated-dimension setup?
methods: Compare direct TDB callsites in pinned AE2025 and AE2026 DLLs
Determine duplicate guard, mutex ownership, immediate CreateStream and canonical call chains; do not call private code
observed_result: In both versions, RegisterFactoryFunc invokes CreateStream immediately; conditional RegisterSeparatedDimensions subsequently uses RegisterCanonicalInstance. No external type registered.
limits: Callback ABI and valid virtual interface not reconstructed
